decision_rationale: The paper presents finetuned LLMs/MLLMs and explicitly frames them as generative models for genomic and proteomic tasks. It also describes broad pretrained biomedical base models and adaptation to multiple downstream tasks.
evidence_snippet: "generative Large Language Models (LLMs)"; "generation of descriptions for gene functions"; "open-source LLMs trained using a wide range of biomedical data"; "multiple downstream tasks by adaption"
